item.title: Version 1.1.28
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.28

  • RSI Technical Indicator Polish: Cleaned up redundant in-chart title badges on 70/50/30 threshold lines to match TradingView standards, while keeping threshold axis labels cleanly linked to the setting.
  • Live RSI Current Value Badge: Added a prominent live RSI value badge on the vertical price scale that tracks real-time price changes.
  • Superchart Performance: Optimized symbol switching on Superchart to eliminate UI lag and ensure smooth rendering.
